mapper.select: SELECT guild_id, name AS guild_name FROM guilds WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT dns.summary_date AS stat_date, COUNT(DISTINCT dns.user_id) AS count_value FROM daily_nutrition_summaries dns JOIN guild_members gm ON gm.user_id = dns.user_id WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL AND dns.summary_date BETWEEN #{weekStartDate} AND #{weekEndDate} GROUP BY dns.summary_date ORDER BY dns.summary_date ASC

SELECT bb.battle_id, bb.guild_id, b.name AS boss_name, b.difficulty, bb.status, bb.max_hp, bb.current_hp, bb.total_damage FROM boss_battles bb JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id WHERE bb.guild_id = #{guildId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN bb.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, bb.started_at DESC, bb.battle_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT bb.battle_id, bb.guild_id, b.name AS boss_name, b.difficulty, bb.status, bb.max_hp, bb.current_hp, bb.total_damage FROM boss_battles bb JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id WHERE bb.battle_id = #{battleId}

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(completed_at, updated_at) AS DATE) AS stat_date, COUNT(1) AS count_value FROM quests WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REWARDED') AND CAST(COALESCE(completed_at, updated_at) AS DATE) BETWEEN #{weekStartDate} AND #{weekEndDate} GROUP BY CAST(COALESCE(completed_at, updated_at) AS DATE) ORDER BY stat_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM quests WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REWARDED')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM boss_battle_conditions WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} AND completed = TRUE
